# SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.4 Scientific-Owner Freeze

Date: `2026-08-20`

Owner statement:

> Freeze SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.4.

Status: Scientific authority frozen; implementation conformity not yet assessed
under this contract.

## Frozen Authority

The owner statement freezes SCI-PTC v0.1/r0.4 as the scientific authority for
the scope represented by:

- the standalone science-team rationale and its companion six-file shared
  normative core;
- the engineering conformance view, whose view-specific guidance is
  informative and introduces no independent normative science;
- `PTC-SCOPE-D001--D017`, `PTC-OWNER-Q001--Q002`, and the preceding approved
  packet and review decisions;
- the 27 author decisions, the scientific-owner decision ledger, and the exact
  139-row authority crosswalk; and
- the two canonical v0.1/r0.4 PDF renderings recorded in `pdf/README.md`.

The six open, four known-but-not-supplied, and two deferred detailed-ledger
entries retain their recorded states. Freezing the authority does not supply a
missing number, estimator, threshold, support policy, response domain,
covariance model, adjacent-owner input, or validation evidence and does not
make a blocked operation or claim available. The two decided entries retain
their recorded authority.

## Claim Boundary

This freeze establishes scientific authority only. It does not assert or
provide evidence of implementation conformity, representation/response
fidelity, scientific validation, observational performance, science
qualification, or production readiness. Those are later, separately
authorized review and validation activities.

The next planned activity is the RTC--CAL--PTC response and lifecycle coherence
review. That cross-package review may identify a need for successor authority,
but it does not silently amend this frozen revision.

## Change Control

The freeze is status-only: it changes no normative identifier, equation,
definition, assumption, requirement, prediction, owner-ledger state, or
scientific meaning in r0.4. Any future substantive correction, resolved open
choice, or changed scientific boundary requires explicit owner authority and a
versioned successor or formally reopened revision. Frozen r0.4 authority must
not be silently edited.
